observations: Recessed black plastic handles on each drawer.
Lock cylinder located at the top right corner.
Small blue and white stickers are present on each drawer front and the top left corner, but text is illegible.
The unit is standing on cardboard, suggesting a retail or warehouse environment.
External surfaces appear clean with no major visible dents or scratches in this view.

risks.if_unproven: as having stiff or damaged runners.

risks.risk: Lock may be broken or the key may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the key and a video showing the lock engaging and disengaging.
risks.if_unproven: as having no key and a non-functional lock.

risks.risk: Internal rust or structural damage inside the drawers.
risks.proof: Photos of the interior of each drawer.
risks.if_unproven: as having internal rust or floor damage.

proof_requests: Video showing all drawers opening and closing smoothly.
Photo of the key and a demonstration of the lock working.
Photos of the inside of the drawers to check for rust.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by type as a 4-drawer filing cabinet. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (no key, stiff drawers) based on the single external photo.
